topics.description: AWS Step Functions is a serverless workflow orchestration service that coordinates distributed applications using state machines. Workflow patterns include sequential, parallel, branching, error handling, and callback patterns for long-running processes.

Best practices for AWS Lambda covering function configuration (memory, timeout, concurrency), performance optimization (cold starts, warmers), error handling (retries, DLQs), security (IAM, VPC), and operational excellence (logging, monitoring, tracing).

ECS Capacity Providers manage cluster capacity across Fargate and EC2 launch types. Covers capacity provider strategies, auto-scaling policies, managed scaling, and cluster capacity management for container workloads.

The Serverless Applications Lens extends the AWS Well-Architected Framework with serverless-specific best practices across operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization pillars.

Tactical Domain-Driven Design approach for identifying aggregate boundaries, modeling consistency rules, designing aggregate roots, and managing domain events using structured heuristics and design canvases.

Comprehensive microservices pattern catalog covering decomposition patterns (by business capability, subdomain), communication patterns (API gateway, event-driven), data patterns (database per service, CQRS, saga), and observability patterns.

Industry-standard REST API design guidelines covering URL structure conventions, resource modeling, versioning strategies, pagination patterns, error response formats, naming conventions, and API governance practices.

PostgreSQL performance optimization covering query planning and execution analysis, index utilization strategies, memory and buffer configuration, vacuum and autovacuum tuning, and connection pooling best practices.

Redis usage patterns covering caching strategies (write-through, cache-aside), rate limiting with sorted sets, session storage, pub/sub messaging, real-time leaderboards, distributed locks, and Redis Cluster configuration.

OAuth 2.0 security best practices from IETF covering authorization code flow with PKCE, redirect URI validation, CSRF protection with state parameter, refresh token rotation, sender-constrained tokens, and token binding.

Staff engineer career path covering scope and responsibilities, technical strategy, cross-organizational influence, mentorship, and navigation of the staff-plus engineering role beyond traditional management tracks.

Creating effective engineering strategies through context analysis, strategic choice identification, action planning, and organizational alignment. Covers strategy creation patterns for engineering leaders.
